title: [v0.92.2][CF-REMEDIATE] Generate a bounded remediation plan from review findings
review_findings: Latest exact review of PR #1012 at ac0f8651d2e6 found one P2: planner path extraction corrupted dot-directory repository paths and omitted root files. Evidence: `.github/workflows/ci.yml` became `github/workflows/ci.yml`, and `Cargo.toml` was omitted because the path detector required `/`.
review_dispositions: Finding accepted and remediated. `relevant_paths` now normalizes only quotes/commas/semicolons and trims trailing sentence punctuation without stripping a leading dot. Path detection now accepts validated root files containing a dot as well as slash-containing paths. Added regression coverage for `.github/workflows/ci.yml:42` and `Cargo.toml`, including an assertion that `github/workflows/ci.yml` is not emitted.
review_notes: Prior review PASS/review truth is superseded by this remediation. Fresh independent exact-head review is required against the new immutable commit before publication or merge.
